a: Up to $40,000/yr per investigator (student stipend, travel, computing)
dt: Tied to accepted proposals; separate rounds roughly Sep (ALMA), Dec and Jun (VLA/VLBA/GBT); NRAO lists no active SOS call now
e: PI (not a student or postdoc) at the student's institution applies after an accepted GBT/VLA/VLBA/ALMA project. Can fund students working on GBT pulsar-timing or radio projects.
unv: Next SOS deadline not posted; whether non-US institutions are eligible not stated
